decision: Implement a separate, locally bundled Tiptap React editor that is dynamically loaded only for non-comic Author Studio chapter forms and serializes to imperial_rich_text_chapter v1.
invariants: The shared reader/community React island bundle must not include Tiptap.
The editor bundle loads only inside an eligible Author Studio chapter form.
The plain-text textarea remains usable if the editor bundle fails.
Editor output is normalized to the server-validated structured chapter envelope.
Comic chapter composition remains on its existing path.
No raw HTML, image upload, external CDN, paid feature, D1 migration, or production deploy is introduced.
acceptance: Build creates a versioned local editor bundle and reports raw/gzip size.
Editor toolbar is keyboard accessible and has 44px touch targets.
Heading levels are restricted to 2/3; code blocks are disabled; link URLs are HTTP(S) only.
Chapter save posts structured JSON to the existing author API.
Build and all CI governance checks pass.
releaseBoundary: Author Studio client-side editor only. Deployment and live mobile QA remain separate.
